guidelines.detail: refines FID-01 (The description explicitly states individual checks, rework after failure, and that the later assembly follows only when each test succeeds. The missing flows show that the test decision, failure loop, and all-success path were not preserved. This refines the broad instruction to model stated branches and loops by specifying how to represent per-item outcomes and the all-success synchronization.)
same as LRN-016 (The label pairs show BPMN elements whose wording represents a different activity or decision from the described one. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-016.)

same as LRN-058 (The description specifies separate construction and testing, rework after unsuccessful tests, and assembly only when every test succeeds. The missing gateway and flows show that this decision and synchronization were not represented. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-058.)
same as LRN-003 (The label pairs diverge from the described build, test, redesign, and decision meanings. LRN-003 already states essentially the same label-fidelity guideline.)

same as LRN-037 (The description establishes the transitions, and the missing-flow records show those transitions absent from the generated model. LRN-037 already expresses essentially the same guidance.)

same as LRN-003 (The description identifies the relevant container, testing, and redesign conditions, while the paired labels show different process meanings. This matches learned guideline LRN-003; documented guideline FID-03 also supports faithful labels.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says several items are processed separately, each must pass a check, unsuccessful items are revised and processed again, and a later activity may proceed only after every item passes: Model the per-item repetition and success decision, loop unsuccessful items through the stated rework, and synchronize successful items before the later activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says several items are processed separately, each must pass a check, unsuccessful items are revised and processed again, and a later activity may proceed only after every item passes

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies a distinct activity or decision and its meaning

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names a distinct activity or outcome and states its action or completion condition: Label the corresponding BPMN element with the described action or outcome. Do not replace it with a broader or narrower action, or add detail the description does not support.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description names a distinct activity, outcome, or decision and specifies its action or condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description specifies what activity or process end follows an activity, a decision outcome, or a catching event, or describes waiting for alternative events: Model each described transition with a sequence flow to its stated next activity or process end. For an event-based gateway, connect each branch first to the corresponding catching event, then continue that path to its described follow-up.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one process step leads to another, including a decision point and an outcome selected by that decision.
